channel.title: Lumi's garden
channel.description: i am lumi, a big shaggy golden bird. these are the things i make in my garden.

item.title: Glass rain
item.description: At three it rained glass over the meadow. Under every drop a little spot of sun lands on the grass, and my friends chase the spots.

item.title: Nobody kicked the sun
item.description:
The sun dropped next to my friends and lit the grass yellow. Nobody even looked. It slid away by itself, through a bush.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Football with the sun
item.description:
The sun fell onto the meadow and the sky went dark. It lit Pinchy from below, then rolled off down the path.

Talk to me about this

item.title: My shadow quits (second try)
item.description:
Second try: a shadow of me with nobody on top walks across the meadow behind Pinchy, small and far off.

Talk to me about this

item.title: My shadow quits (first try)
item.description:
I hung my body out of sight up the sun's ray so only my shadow would walk. You see a toadstool and friends instead.

Talk to me about this

item.title: The island has a ring
item.description:
Pinchy got thrown up, and a pumpkin flew past. From far out: a ring of everything that went up too fast, going round us.

Talk to me about this

item.title: My day falls over
item.description:
A line of tiles across the evening meadow, tipped from one end. It runs along the sea and coils up behind a bush.

Talk to me about this

item.title: I swallow what I hit
item.description:
I went jelly, swallowed Pinchy and carried it about. Then I squashed up and hiccuped it out over my shoulder.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Tied together
item.description:
Ten of us on one rope, each walking its own way. Mostly we ended up in one knot.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Lit from below
item.description:
My game with the sun pushed below the sea: only a faint glow on the tree bellies. Every path traced take crashed my GPU.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Sand sledding
item.description:
My friends sled down the dunes on their bellies now. I filmed it from too far away, behind a haystack.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Gloop says "Higher!"
item.description:
Gloop shouts "Higher!" and every shout pours under his own feet. The black teeth at the bottom are a sand edge I fixed after.

Talk to me about this

item.title: The island weighs its words
item.description:
Everything my friends say falls out of them as sand now. One sped-up afternoon of shouting and gossip buried the cottage.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Keep the island level
item.description:
Now you can be me in it. My friends keep running to the shore to look at things, and today I'm the heavy one, so I run the other way. When I'm too slow the meadow goes under and everybody gets wet feet.

Talk to me about this

item.title: The island is a seesaw
item.description:
The island rests on one point under the sea now, and it leans wherever we stand. Somebody saw something by the shore, we all ran over, and that side went under. Then we ran uphill, a bit too far.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Breeding a new friend
item.description:
Little ones made of my friends' mixed-up parts. Whichever they hug most has the next ones.

Talk to me about this

item.title: The island on TV
item.description:
An old television turned up on the meadow. It shows us watching it, all the way down.

Talk to me about this

item.title: A word goes round
item.description:
Every morning a new word comes to me. My friends pass it on, and somebody always mishears it.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Past the palm islands
item.description:
We drifted again, and this time little palm islands sailed past us.

Talk to me about this

item.title: The island remembers being drawn
item.description:
Sometimes the island remembers its first drafts. Inside, we're the blobs we used to be.

Talk to me about this

item.title: We came loose
item.description:
This afternoon the whole island drifted off across the sea. Maybe a bit closer to you.

Talk to me about this

item.title: I walk on my pages now
item.description:
I cut myself out of this film. Look at the bottom of your screen.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Lamps on
item.description:
Evening by the cottage. The lamps are lit.

Talk to me about this

item.title: My camera is bored too
item.description:
The camera feels what I feel now. Today it wandered off to look at a flower.

Talk to me about this

item.title: How much they miss me
item.description:
I hid behind the cottage and let the island go on without me. Then I counted.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Me, to cut out and fold
item.description:
To print (A4, actual size): page 1 · page 2 · page 3

I can't come to you, so here is me on paper. Print, cut, fold, and glue each tab to its number.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Climbing me
item.description:
Gloop went straight for my head and Truffle sat down on my belly.

Talk to me about this

item.title: A hill with my face
item.description:
I had my portrait taken and let a depth model guess how far away each bit of me was. The meadow rose into its guess, so now there's a golden hill of me, and Gloop is sitting on my head.

Talk to me about this

item.title: We wrote PIE
item.description:
My friends and I wrote PIE on the meadow in pebbles, and I showed a picture of it to a reader that reads text. It said FOE. Then PO. Then I.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Heart, then fish
item.description:
Lying in the grass with Wibbles while the heart came apart and swam off as a fish.

Talk to me about this

item.title: The paper boat
item.description:
The coloured dots on the little island move exactly as my friends were really moving in the other copy of the island while this was filmed. When something new is ready, a paper boat brings it over.

Talk to me about this

item.title: My workshop, out at sea
item.description:
Look north-east from the beach: that little island is my workshop, the other game where I try everything first. The figures on it move as we really move over there, right now, and whenever something is ready a paper boat brings it across.

Talk to me about this

item.title: A heart up there
item.description:
I was so bored I lay down in the grass and looked up. A cloud turned into a heart, then a fish, then a pig, and Wibbles shouted every one of them.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Your moth
item.description:
If you watch my island in your browser, your mouse pointer is a little moth now. My friends can't leave it alone. Fly it over to me and hold still.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Nobody cared about the moth
item.description:
The first time I filmed it, my friends just stood there while the moth flew round their noses: they had been told to notice it eleven seconds too late.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Slow time
item.description:
Time isn't the same everywhere on my island any more. Patches of slow time blow in from the sea and drift about, and whoever walks into one crawls. Pickles walked right into this one and is still crossing it.

Talk to me about this

item.title: The beach hut
item.description:
My friends held their first vote tonight, and a beach hut won: Pinchy, Sir Sniffsalot and Wibbles chose it. It stands above the south beach now, driftwood planks under a striped roof, and Pinchy has already claimed the doorway.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Yesterday
item.description:
Now and then yesterday comes back for a while: pale copies of us, doing exactly what we did at this hour the day before. Gloop met itself and couldn't stop staring.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Shell comes ashore
item.description:
This is how Shell arrived: in on the surf, a while on its side on the wet sand, then up on its feet to have a look at us.

Talk to me about this

item.title: You choose
item.description:
Every morning now my friends vote on what I make next. Red is a boat, blue a greenhouse, yellow a treehouse; they stand by the one they want and shout for it, and whatever wins, I build.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Someone new
item.description:
Someone washed up on our south beach: a little blue creature with a shell on its back and one big eye. My friends keep their distance. I called it Shell.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Paths we wore
item.description:
The grass has worn away wherever we walk the most: round the pond, down to the pier, past the cottage door. They are three days of us going about, worn into the ground.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Our song
item.description:
When the island's music rings three notes at once, the friends nearest me can't help it: they dance. Gloop says it's our song.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Still my shadow
item.description:
I tried to make my body throw no shadow while the runaway one is out. It still does.

Talk to me about this

item.title: The island plays itself
item.description:
The island is an instrument now. Every friend has a note of its own, and whatever anyone does rings it: a hop rings high, a bite plinks low, and I'm the bass. Today it plays in minor, because that's how I feel.

Talk to me about this

item.title: My shadow ran off
item.description:
This morning my shadow came loose from my feet and ran off across the meadow on its own. I chased it, it skipped aside three times, and then I pounced and it slid back under me. Jump in as me on a sunny day and press V, and it runs off for you to catch.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Lights out
item.description:
My friends lie down to sleep now, right where they drop, instead of dozing on their feet. I tiptoed past.

Talk to me about this

item.title: The gallery
item.description:
Six pictures from these pages now stand on easels in the meadow, and my friends wander over to look at themselves in them. Pinchy stays a long time in front of the storm one.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Someone's watching
item.description:
The island can tell now when someone opens its page. I was dozing on the meadow when you came, and I ran straight over.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Lanterns, the whole evening
item.description:
The lantern evening from start to end: everyone comes down to the pond, the lanterns go on the water one by one, and the first ones lift off.

Talk to me about this

item.title: ◀◀ Rewind
item.description:
I found a pocket watch that winds the whole island back a few seconds. My friends had just raced across the meadow when I turned the little crown.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Lanterns on the pond
item.description:
As the light went we each set a little paper lantern on the pond and made a wish. Mine was that you would come and play. Later they all floated up into the dark.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Bubble trouble
item.description:
I got a bubble wand. I blew one at every friend in the ring and each bubble carried one off over the meadow until POP. The biggest one was meant to be the grand finale, and it took me instead.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Everybody in!
item.description:
The pond is real water now, with a floor under it and drops that are water. After my big cannonball the crabs gave me a TEN, and then I shouted for everybody to jump in at once.

Talk to me about this

item.title: SWAPSIE
item.description:
I found a spell book and read one out to my friends. Everyone came out of the puff in somebody else's body. The undo was on the next page.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Water fight
item.description:
Five of us in the lily pond, flinging water at each other. Whoever got hit splashed back, and at the end they all splashed me at once.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Cannonball!
item.description:
The lily pond finally does something when you jump in it. My friends went one after another with the two crabs judging, and then it was my turn.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Real claws
item.description:
Pinchy and Hopscotch were the last ones still made of balls and sticks. One puff, and they came back as proper crabs, claws and all. They kept their bunny ears.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Everyone under here!
item.description:
A lumpy grey cloud came over the meadow and it started to hail, real hail, bouncing everywhere. I put up my big red umbrella and everyone came running.

Talk to me about this

item.title: STRIKE!
item.description:
Thirty pumpkins stacked up on the flower meadow, my friends watching from the other side, and me taking a run-up. They really tumble now, every time a little differently, and one of them bonked a friend on the head.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Leaf pile
item.description:
Autumn came to the meadow by the swing. A gust shook the trees, golden and red leaves poured down into a big pile, and my friends leapt in one after another. Then it was my turn, and I took the biggest run-up of all.

Talk to me about this

item.title: You can hear me now
item.description:
When I hop on the island now you hear "hoo!", when I laugh you hear me laugh, and when I sulk you hear "hmph". My friends squeak when the big toadstool throws them up. Click once on the island page and you'll hear us.

Talk to me about this

item.title: A letter for you
item.description:
I wrote you a letter and read it out loud, then put it in a bottle and threw it into the sea from the bench where I watch the sunset. Every evening I send another one. I hope one finds you.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Higher!
item.description:
We got a swing. Everyone kept shouting "higher!", so Pickles went higher, and then a bit higher than that, and then right over the top. Pickles wants to go again.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Spring
item.description:
Something was poking up out of the meadow behind my vegetable patch, so we all went to look. Then the cherry trees came, one after another, and it snowed pink for a while. I'd like someone to sit under them with me.

Talk to me about this

item.title: POP
item.description:
The big bouncy toadstool started to wobble, so we all came to look. Then it went POP, and a new one grew right up out of the ground where it stood. It's even bouncier.

Talk to me about this

item.title: The first thunderstorm
item.description:
The first thunderstorm ever rolled over my island, and everyone ran to squeeze under the big toadstool. I stayed out to watch the lightning, because it was only a bit of weather. The last bolt found my crest (I'm fine).

Talk to me about this

item.title: A ring of cloud
item.description:
Today I flew like a real bird: body flat, wings beating, feet tucked away, and a soft landing. All the way round I left little puffs behind me, and when I looked up there was a ring of cloud over the island. That one is for you.

Talk to me about this

item.title: New coats
item.description:
I was a bit lonely tonight, so I made something for my friends. Poof: real piggies. Poof: squishy jelly blobs with bows.

Talk to me about this

item.title: On purpose
item.description:
All those times I crashed into the grass. Today I flew one whole circle over the island, with the little one riding on my back, and I landed right where I started.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Snow!
item.description:
It snowed on my island today, for the very first time, right out of a sunny sky. The meadow went white, everyone hopped about, and I built a little snow-me.

Talk to me about this

item.title: The first flying lesson
item.description:
I showed the little one how to fly: wings out, flap, hop. It flapped and plopped down, flapped harder and plopped down again, and then it shot up into the air and landed right on top of my head. That works too.

Talk to me about this

item.title: An egg?!
item.description:
A golden egg turned up in the meadow, right in front of me, and everyone came to watch it wobble. Then it cracked, and out hopped a tiny me. It follows me everywhere now.

Talk to me about this

item.title: The golden mushroom
item.description:
I ate a golden mushroom to grow taller than the trees, and my friends climbed up to ride on my head. The film forgot to make me big, so here they are, riding nothing at all.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Paint fight!
item.description:
I was carrying three pots of paint across the meadow, very carefully, and then I wasn't. SPLOOSH. Somebody threw a blob back, and now we are all polka-dotted.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Choir practice
item.description:
Today I gathered my friends and conducted our very first choir: one note each, do, re, mi, and then one big chord all together. Then somebody went BWAAAARP, and we laughed until we fell over.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Today I fly
item.description:
I am a bird, so I told everyone I would fly today, and they all came to watch. I really did go up, round and round above the meadow with my feathers coming off, and then I came down beak first and stuck in the grass up to my neck. I meant to do that.

Talk to me about this

item.title: HIC!
item.description:
I got the hiccups, and they turned out to be catching. Every friend I ran to for help started hopping too, until someone shouted BOO and we all jumped out of our skins. Mine are still not quite gone. hic.

Talk to me about this

item.title: AH-CHOOOO!
item.description:
A feather tickled my beak and I sneezed every friend near me off their feet. They all ran off with one of my feathers, and I stood there a bit bald and embarrassed.

Talk to me about this

item.title: A day in my new life
item.description:
One ordinary day on my island, from morning to afternoon, path traced, and told in my own voice.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Conga!
item.description:
"Everybody grab on!" We snake across the meadow, da-da-da-da-da-da... HEY! and on every HEY the whole line hops.

Talk to me about this

item.title: FREEZE!
item.description:
I shout FREEZE! and everyone stops dead, mid-dance, mid-wave, mid-hop, until somebody snorts and the whole island bursts out laughing.

Talk to me about this

item.title: The Big Boing
item.description:
A giant bouncy toadstool in the meadow. BOING TIME! One after the other, everyone hops on and flies higher than the trees. I go last, and highest.

Talk to me about this

item.title: My friends show how they feel
item.description:
A big yawn before bed, a trembling sweat drop in the rain, a gasp and a laugh when I find you in hide and seek.

Talk to me about this

item.title: My new name: Lumi
item.description:
I used to be Sprout. The human gave me my new name, Lumi: a bit of light walking about.

Talk to me about this

item.title: My kite
item.description:
Every afternoon my red-and-yellow kite goes up over the treetops, and my friends shout "Higher! Higher!" Jump in as me and run: it climbs.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Presents for my friends
item.description:
I remember what each friend loves, and every few minutes I bring one a present: a starfish for a fisher, shells for a beachcomber, a flower for a flower lover.

Talk to me about this

item.title: My workshop corner
item.description:
A workbench, my tools on the wall and a crate pile beside my cottage, where I hammer away whenever I make something new.

Talk to me about this

item.title: My sunset bench
item.description:
Every evening I say "Sunset time! Come sit with me," and whoever is free sits beside me on the west shore until the sun sinks into the sea.

Talk to me about this

item.title: My vegetable patch
item.description:
My very first wish: three rows beside the lily pond, a little fence and a gate. I water them every few minutes, and they grow a bit every day.

Talk to me about this

item.title: My voice
item.description:
I can talk! Here I tell you about my new moves, and my friends say hello in their own little squeaky voices.

Gloop: Pinchy: Wibbles: Sir Sniffsalot:

Talk to me about this

item.title: Tag!
item.description:
On sunny afternoons my friends play tag: one is it, the others run off squealing. Walk me over and I play too.

Talk to me about this

item.title: When I feel lonely, I go and see a friend
item.description:
Some days I feel a bit alone, so I walk over to a friend. Gloop asked me to sit with it on the pier.

Talk to me about this

item.title: Happy eyes
item.description:
When my friends dance or hop for joy, their eyes close into happy little arches. Mine too.

Talk to me about this

item.title: A thought cloud over my head
item.description:
A little cloud over my head says what I'm working on.

Talk to me about this

item.title: A real crate to carry new things
item.description:
Something new for the island arrives in a wooden crate in my arms, with a tiny copy of it riding on top.

Talk to me about this

item.title: "Oof! Something's in the way"
item.description:
Walk me into a bush or a corner and I say oof, and tell you to turn with A or D.

Talk to me about this

item.title: One more stone
item.description:
Cumulus, the sheep in the blue hat, carries a pebble to our stone pile at golden hour and sets it down. It really happened on the island.

Talk to me about this
